commands.label: Run the official 4D command for standard output in the isolated project

source_changes.replacement: LOG EVENT(Into system standard outputs; "Hello, World!")

semantic_scope: Official tool4d executed the finalized 4D method in headless mode. The documented LOG EVENT output channel emitted the exact greeting on standard output.

updated_expectation.semantic_goal: Send the exact greeting to standard output from a native 4D project method.
updated_expectation.build_command: tool4d loads the project and checks the method while executing it.
updated_expectation.expected_result: Tool4D exits successfully and prints exactly Hello, World! to standard output.

path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
